Subject: Vendor portal onboarding: NovaHealth security intake

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this — NovaHealth is starting our vendor portal onboarding for Redwood. We typically collect SOC reports, CAIQ/CAIQ-Lite responses, and a completed SIG-lite. Our team prefers Whistic or Vendr for importer convenience, but we can accept OneTrust exports if needed.

Can you confirm the following by EOD Wednesday?
- Which portal you can use for automated imports (Whistic/Vendr/OneTrust)
- Whether you can grant a short-lived upload token or if we should accept a Drive/S3 handoff
- A point of contact for quick clarifying questions during ingestion (email + 1-hr window)

We also need the latest SOC 2 Type II and CAIQ snapshot. If possible, please upload the SOC2 PDF and a CAIQ spreadsheet export. Our procurement team is working to close the intake this week — goal is to have the profile live by next Tues 12/7.

Attachments: NovaHealth_RFI_Template.xlsx (XLSX)

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Vendor Risk, NovaHealth
elena.morales@novahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding: NovaHealth security intake

Elena — thanks for the clear list. High-level plan below and a few Qs.

Plan
- Primary import channel: Vendr (we can push manifest via API and support per-field CAIQ mapping). Vendr gives the cleanest sync for our metadata.
- Fallback: S3 handoff to a pre-signed bucket (we'll ingest CSV/ZIP) if API token can't be provisioned.
- I will be the intake lead; cc'ing Security Ops internally for review/approval.

Questions
1) For CAIQ: do you need full CAIQ or CAIQ-Lite? We can produce both; Lite will be faster.
2) Does procurement require the SOC2 cover letter redacted? We can upload the full PDF to a secure bucket and provide access link.

I attached the current SOC2 and our CAIQ export sample so you can validate fields. I'm available Wed 11/29 2pm-3pm PT for a quick sync; if that works I can invite the Vendr onboarding engineer.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (PDF); redwood_caiaq_responses_2027.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
